# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Capability under optimization: **system-prompt only** (`prompt.md`). No `tools.py` exists in this
edit space. Reader = `aws/claude-sonnet-4-5` (strong). Mechanics: agent writes Python in a REPL
loop (```python block executes; output returns as a user turn), up to 5 rounds; the FINAL code is
re-run on 3 hidden files with the same layout but different data/size. Reward = fraction of the 3
matching the checked range. I built on the **seed** prompt (cand_0001 was REJECTED and reverted).

## Ranked issue list (clusters by leverage = tasks × trials × recoverable score)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Wasted-round XML tool syntax | ALL (55457,347-49,32468,374-9,52216,53161 t1/t3,160-6 t3) | agent emits `<function_calls>/<invoke>` XML instead of a ```python block → round wasted → then rushes a guessed solution | KNOWLEDGE (output contract) | tighten output contract |
| 2 | Fabricated table layout (no inspection) | 53161 t1/t3, 160-6 t3, 52216 t0/t3 | wrote final solution on an assumed layout/orientation/extent it never observed | KNOWLEDGE/BEHAVIORAL | inspect-before-solve rule + match-by-label |
| 3 | "all" quantifier misread | 347-49 (0.00, 3 trials) | upward scan stops at first non-blank (the "Employee Info" label), deletes only 1 of many blank rows | KNOWLEDGE (interpretation) | "apply to every match" rule |
| 4 | read-scope vs write-scope | 160-6 t3 (and 53161) | restricted the source read to inside answer_position; the rows to pull up sit below it | KNOWLEDGE | answer_position = WRITE not READ |
| 5 | formula cells dropped on read | 374-9 (0.13) | read without `data_only`; dropped formula/non-numeric cells from sums → low totals | KNOWLEDGE (technique) | read with data_only=True; don't skip cells |
| 6 | stale pre-existing formula left in target | 52216 t4 (0.67) | overwrote only some target cells; left an original formula whose cached value is stale on hidden data | KNOWLEDGE | fill EVERY target cell with computed value |
| 7 | inclusive period window | 32468 (0.00) | "including the subsequent 12 months" = 13 inclusive buckets; used 12 | KNOWLEDGE (interpretation) | inclusive-endpoint rule + read footnotes |

Skipped: **55457** (0.00) — the `instruction` field is literally empty (a lone ` `); the
transformation is unknowable, so no general rule can recover it without hardcoding. Matches the
prior journal's note; left alone.

## Changes made this iteration (all in prompt.md — additive sections appended after the seed's original bullets, which are kept verbatim to preserve the passing one-shots)
| cluster | edit class | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | output contract | "reply with exactly ONE ```python block; never use `<function_calls>/<invoke>/<parameter>` XML — it doesn't run and wastes the round." | YES — passing tasks already recover from the glitch; fewer wasted rounds only helps |
| 2 | missing rule + match-by-label | "inspect the real layout before solving when unsure; confirm each table's location/orientation(matrix vs records)/true extent; match cross-table pulls by label not position." | YES — 418-29/40467/47484 already inspect first (2 rounds); no header-distrust claim (that likely broke 418-29 in cand_0001) |
| 3 | interpretation rule | "act on EVERY match for 'all X'; a label/subtotal between groups must not stop the scan; example numbers are illustrative." | YES — consistent with 418-29 (delete all dup occurrences) and 160-6 (delete all blanks) |
| 4 | narrowing clarification | "answer_position bounds WRITES, not READS; source may lie outside it; compute post-op contents then write." | YES — does NOT loosen the 'never write outside range' rule; passing tasks read+write within range, unchanged |
| 5 | technique rule | "read with data_only=True; never drop a formula/non-numeric cell from an aggregate." | YES — 40467 writes formulas (reads nothing to aggregate); 47484/418-29 read plain numbers |
| 6 | rule | "populate every cell of answer_position with its computed intended value; don't trust a leftover pre-existing formula." | YES — formula-NEUTRAL wording; 40467 overwrites all of D1:D10 with fixed formulas → still complies |
| 7 | interpretation rule | "'including the subsequent N periods' = N+1 inclusive; read in-sheet footnotes defining ranges." | YES — additive knowledge; no passing task involves such a window |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the new rule changes on those exact inputs; + blast-radius)
- 347-49 (all 5 = 0.00): trials scanned up from "Gross Pay", stopped at the "Employee Info" label (deleted only 1 of ~6 blank rows/block). Rule 3 tells the reader a label between blank groups must not stop the scan → deletes all blank rows above each match. Blast radius: 418-29/160-6 already delete all matches → unchanged.
- 160-6 t3 (0.00 vs 4/5 passing): t3 scanned only rows 6–11 (inside answer_position 'SH'!A6:L11), found no filled rows, wrote blank. Rule 4 states source rows lie below the range → read whole region, then write. Blast radius: passing trials t0/t1/t2/t4 already read rows 12–14 (outside range) → unchanged.
- 53161 t1/t3 (0.00 vs 3/5 passing): both fabricated a non-existent schedule layout without inspecting. Rules 1+2 remove the wasted XML round and require observing the real matrix orientation/extent → matches the passing trials' behavior. Blast radius: passing trials already inspect → unchanged.
- 374-9 (0.13): winning trials t0/t3 used `data_only=True` and kept formula cells (col H `=SUM`, inline `=…`); losing trials dropped them → low sums. Rule 5 encodes the winning technique. Blast radius: 40467/47484/418-29 don't aggregate formula cells → unchanged.
- 52216 t4 (0.67, test 3 fails): left row-15's pre-existing formula (stale on hidden data). Rule 6 requires writing computed values to every target cell. Blast radius: 40467 already rewrites all target cells → unchanged.
- 32468 (all 5 = 0.00): clean trials computed a 12-bucket window; correct is 13 ("start + subsequent 12 months"). Rule 7 encodes inclusive-endpoint counting. Blast radius: no passing task uses a rolling window → unchanged.
- Edit 1 verified against passing: 47484 t0/t2/t4 emitted XML yet still passed (recovered next round); removing the wasted round cannot lower their score.

## Process & features used
- Subagents: 5 read-only Explore subagents in parallel, one per failing/flaky cluster (55457; 347-49;
  32468; {374-9,52216}; {53161,160-6}), each reading all 5 trial files and reporting root cause +
  pass/fail discriminator + a general (non-hardcoding) rule. Merged their findings into 7 clusters.
- Prior iterations read: cand_0001 PROCESS.md + diff.patch + its REJECTED result (broke 418-29, fixed
  160-6). Lesson applied: cand_0001 rewrote the whole prompt and, critically, claimed "the preview
  mislabels the first data row as a header — distrust pandas headers / read by coordinate." 418-29's
  winning code depends on `pd.read_excel(header=None)`, so that claim most plausibly caused the
  regression. I did NOT re-introduce it. I kept the seed verbatim and only appended additive rules.

## Good things to PRESERVE (do not let a future iteration undo these)
- The seed's original 6 bullets verbatim (they drive the passing one-shots 47484/418-29/40467).
- Do NOT add any anti-formula rule — 40467 passes writing LIVE formulas; the grader recalculates. (Refuted in cand_0001.)
- Do NOT claim the preview mislabels headers / tell the agent to distrust pandas header handling — correlated with the 418-29 regression in cand_0001.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- 55457: empty/broken instruction (` `), transformation unknowable — not prompt-fixable without hardcoding.
- Any rewrite of the seed's opening/bullets: preserved to protect the 3 solid tasks.
